plan.notes: Source: official Drexel University 2024-2025 Undergraduate Catalog, College of Computing & Informatics (Drexel's official catalog archive, deptapp16.drexel.edu): 'Computer Science BSCS' -- Major: Computer Science; Degree Awarded: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (BSCS); Calendar Type: Quarter; Minimum Required Credits: 187.0; Coop Options: Three Coop (Five years); One Coop (Four years). Hand-transcribed 2026-09-30 from the catalog's official 'Sample Plan of Study -- 4-Year, 1 coop' track (the standard 4-year sequence; the 5-year/3-coop track was not used). Per-term credit totals verified against the catalog: 16, 17.5, 17.5, 17, 15, 16, 16, 17, 13, 16, 13, 13 = 187. STALENESS CAVEAT: the live 2027-2028 catalog (catalog.drexel.edu) renumbered the CS curriculum (e.g. CS 164 -> CS 1030) under a 120-credit structure but publishes no retrievable term-by-term sequence, so this 2024-2025 archived edition is the most recent complete official sequence; catalog_year is set honestly to 2024-2025. Quarter-system plan: 12 academic quarters; Year 3 Spring and Summer are co-op terms with no coursework (omitted as course-less terms). UNIV CI101 ('The Drexel Experience', 2.0 cr) is split 1.0 + 1.0 across Fall and Spring of Year 1 in the official plan; the second instance is coded UNIV CI101-2. 'Science Lab' slots = one lab-science sequence chosen from BIO 131-136, CHEM 101-103, or PHYS 101/102/201. Prerequisites are not published in the sample plan and are left empty rather than invented.
